final_message:
Blog post URLs now keep the base letter for accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause was the vendored `slugify` (1.2.0), which deletes anything outside `a-z0-9`, accented letters included. `vendor/` is off-limits per `CLAUDE.md`, so I changed the wrapper in `src/blog/slug.js` instead. It now decomposes the title and strips the combining accent marks before calling `slugify`.

`src/shop/product-url.js` calls the vendored `slugify` directly, so shop URLs still drop accented letters. I left it alone since you only asked about blog posts. The same fix would work there if you want it.
